title: Time in Daylight
body: Time spent in outdoor activities like outdoor walk or outdoor cycling is not shown as time in daylight. Apple Watch records only that time in which sun shines on the watch. If the watch is hidden under the sleeve, the watch doesn’t record that as time in daylight.
author: Arshad Siraj
